title: GAMA releases 2Q 2026 aircraft shipment and billing report
summary: Shipments through the second quarter of 2026 saw piston helicopters increase by 5.8% with 110 units, and turbine helicopters increase by 3.3% with 309 units.
body_markdown:
The General Aviation Manufacturers Association (GAMA) has published its Second Quarter 2026 General Aviation Aircraft Shipment and Billing Report.


The results for the first six months of 2026, when compared to the same period in 2025, show increased overall shipments and an increase in the value of aircraft billings.


Helicopter shipments through the second quarter of 2026, when compared to the same period in 2025, saw piston helicopters increase by 5.8% with 110 units, and turbine helicopters increase by 3.3% with 309 units.


The billings for civil-commercial helicopters were $2.2 billion.


*This press release was prepared and distributed by the General Aviation Manufacturing Association.*
